rows.target:
<op()><sp(20)>Hari, stay calm.
Let's leave this to everyone out there.<ab(1000)><ed()>

rows.target:
<op()><sp(20)>Thanks to all of you, the Nadesico

...This is real combat!<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.notes: The brat is an insult aimed at the rival in rows778-780, not a reference to Barrel. No speaker label assigned without event metadata.

rows.target: <op()><sp(20)>...What did you say?<ab(100)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>You two! Save your squabbling for later!<ab(500)><ed()>

<on()><sp(20)>Captain, there are way too many enemies!!<ab(10000)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>It's all right.
Everyone has come to help us.<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Captain, preparations to fire are complete!<ab(10000)><off()>

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>You! What do you think you're doing?<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Are you that eager to settle this?<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>You bastard...!<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>You son of a bitch!<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>H-hey! What are you doing at a time like this!?<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>If you keep dawdling, you'll get hit!<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>Gravity Blast, fire.<ab(10000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>What the hell do you think you're doing!?

<on()><sp(20)>Your two units' movements were drawing the enemy together.
That was the best moment to fire.
rows.notes: The enemy gathered around both squabbling craft, explaining the firing decision in800; not a claim that the two craft were enemy units.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>I knew the two of you would be able to dodge it.

<on()><sp(20)>...
I'm honored by your confidence in us, but...
<on()><sp(20)>Lieutenant Commander <color(4)>Hoshino<ce()>, it's been a while.
rows.notes: Naval rank Lieutenant Commander supported by Prince of Darkness character references. Review cross-batch rank normalization.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>You haven't changed either, <color(4)>Amuro<ce()>.

<on()><sp(20)>I'm sorry about what happened to <book(22)>the Tenkawas<endbook()>.
I heard they had adopted you.
rows.notes: The couple is Akito and Yurika Tenkawa per Ruri biography; source uses family reference, so personal names are not added.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>No, please don't worry about me.
I'm all right now.

<on()><sp(20)>Instead, could you tell me
what the recovery team's investigation found?

<on()><sp(20)>Yes.
They examined the downed <book(35)>Zentradi<endbook()> craft,
and apparently all of them were unmanned.
<on()><sp(20)>Unmanned?

<on()><sp(20)>All they found in the cockpits was residue from those life-forms.
It had apparently spread into the electronics
and even inside the components.
<on()><sp(20)>Parasitism...?

<on()><sp(20)>Good grief...
So we're dealing with monsters,
not <book(35)>Zentradi<endbook()>.
<on()><sp(20)>Then finding out what's causing this is urgent.

<on()><sp(20)>Commander <color(4)>Misumaru<ce()> has reported finding something
that may be connected to this incident.
Apparently, it's still only a hypothesis.
rows.notes: Independent review: Restores that a relevant object has actually been located; only its connection remains hypothetical.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>It's apparently an abandoned experimental facility
called the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>.
We're heading there immediately.
rows.notes: Existing glossary explicitly fixes provisional Baldora Drive despite the Japanese -dona spelling. Source calls it an experimental facility here; do not overwrite that with device description from general glossary.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>Understood.
The <book(20)>Nadesico B<endbook()> will now join <book(10)>Londo Bell<endbook()>.

<on()><sp(20)>Oh, Lieutenant <color(4)>Dyson<ce()> and Chief <color(4)>Bowman<ce()>,
orders have arrived for both of you.
rows.notes: Chief renders civilian organizational title, not a military rank. Guld is a civilian researcher/test pilot in Macross Compendium.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>"<book(85)>Project Super Nova<endbook()> has been canceled
following the adoption of the new
<book(86)>X-9 Ghost<endbook()>.

to transfer to <book(10)>Londo Bell<endbook()>.
rows.notes: Existing glossary alias Isamu Dyson preserves the source name form rather than adding Alva.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>Chief <color(4)>Guld Bowman<ce()> is to end his secondment
and return to corporate headquarters."
...Those are the orders.
rows.notes: Source gives Guld Bowman, omitting canonical middle name Goa; preserve that source form. End of quoted transfer order.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>Hey...
Wait a minute! What the hell is this!?
Explain it so it makes sense!
<on()><sp(20)>Insulting a superior officer is an offense.
rows.notes: Independent review: Restores the explicit disciplinary-offense meaning, rather than only describing impoliteness.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>I don't give a damn!!
<on()><sp(20)>Blaming the lieutenant commander won't solve anything.
rows.notes: Rank is the same Hoshino rank as807, not a new officer.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)><color(4)>Guld<ce()>... Are you
really okay with this!?

<on()><sp(20)>Damn it...!
I'm not going to let this stand...!

<on()><sp(20)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>, orders regarding your status
have also arrived from <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> headquarters.

<on()><sp(20)>"<color(4)>Barrel Orland<ce()>.
Effective today, under special wartime provisions,
you are appointed a second lieutenant in <book(10)>Londo Bell<endbook()>."
rows.notes: Second lieutenant follows Federation pilot context, distinct from naval Nadesico rank terminology.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>S-second lieutenant? But I'm a civilian!?

<on()><sp(20)>It's in recognition of your abilities.
<color(4)>Faye<ce()>'s report also rated you highly.
<on()><sp(20)>Even so!!

<on()><sp(20)>Looks like you'll just have to accept it.
<color(4)>Faye<ce()>, look after him.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>W-wait a second...
<on()><sp(20)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>, I look forward to working with you again.

uncertainties.issue: Rank/title terminology requires consistent cross-batch normalization. Naval Lieutenant Commander, military Lieutenant/Second Lieutenant, and civilian Chief kept distinct.
Baldora Drive follows existing provisional glossary; this source describes an experimental facility, unlike the general glossary device description.
New names and terms researched or retained as source codes, with formal glossary additions still required.
Fragmentary remark about addressing Nirvash as alone is kept fragmentary; specific emotional interpretation not added.
